string.text: Detector / Geiger / Torch mirror Settings -> Controls. RF Scanner and Glowstick are set here only. Each puts a matching device in the detector slot. Torch toggles your headlamp when equipped, or draws a handheld flashlight when not.
Draws your bolt when you draw an artefact detector (not RF, Geiger, or Glowstick).
Puts an artefact detector in the detector slot. Press again to put away.
Puts a geiger in the detector slot. Press again to put away.
Puts an RF receiver in the detector slot. Press again to put away.
With a headlamp equipped, toggles it normally. Without one, puts a handheld flashlight in the detector slot. Press again to put away. Does nothing if you have neither.
Puts a glowstick in the detector slot (left hand). Press again to put away.
